name: frugworld
description: Frugworld - A zone-of-influence AI simulator game

scripts.lint: npm run lint:client && npm run lint:ai-service && npm run lint:server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:client:fix && npm run lint:ai-service:fix && npm run lint:server:fix
scripts.format: npm run format:client && npm run format:ai-service && npm run format:server
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:client && npm run format:check:ai-service && npm run format:check:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:client && npm run typecheck:ai-service
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix ai-service install
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
